Ricky Pearsall.note: Out for the 2026 season — PCL surgery on his surgically repaired knee.

Jayden Higgins.note: Out for the 2026 season — torn ACL.

Zach Charbonnet.note: ACL tear suffered in the playoffs; expected to miss the start of the season. Kenneth Walker III projects as Seattle's lead back early.

Malik Nabers.note: ACL + meniscus tear, needed a second cleanup surgery in spring 2026. Real chance he opens on PUP (min. 4 games out) — value is discounted hard until he's cleared.

Najee Harris.note: Still working back from a ruptured Achilles; buried in a crowded NYG backfield behind Skattebo and Tracy. Low-priority stash at best.

Christian McCaffrey.note: Missed ~2 weeks of camp with unspecified leg 'tightness' before returning to practice Aug 23. Long injury history (calf/Achilles) makes him a real risk at his ADP.

George Kittle.note: Off the PUP list Aug 23 in his recovery from a torn Achilles; trending toward a Week 1 return but could slip a week.

Sam LaPorta.note: Missed practice with a hip injury; trending the wrong way heading into camp's final stretch.

Luther Burden III.note: Expected to miss the preseason with a groin injury; team hopeful for Week 1.

Josh Jacobs.note: Dealing with a groin injury in camp; no real Week 1 concern yet, just a flag to monitor.
